d: The wait for the next James Bond is over! British actor Robert Pattinson has been announced as the new Agent 007, becoming the first actor to take on the iconic role since Daniel Craig's departure. The Bond franchise began in 1962 with Sean Connery starring in Dr. No and has since become one of Hollywood's longest-running and highest-grossing film series. With more than $7 billion in global box office collections, Pattinson now steps into one of cinema's most recognisable roles. Hem Saroya tells you more.
